hardware.variant: YS-M33 tablet with an Allwinner A133 and retained vendor U-Boot.

inputs.name: NetBSD 11.1 (EMBER64) #0 AArch64 Image, built from the base revision and local candidate changes
Android v2 RAM boot container with that Image

scenario: At the vendor U-Boot prompt, set the UDISK root in the volatile boot arguments and control device tree. Boot the container from RAM.
expected: The general EMBER64 kernel selects the UDISK root without operator input at the kernel prompt.
observed: NetBSD 11.1 (EMBER64) #0 mounted UDISK as a read-write FFS root on dk16 without a root prompt. The tablet subsequently returned to its installed operating system.
limits: One RAM boot with manually selected loader settings. The boot partition was not written. Board revision and test duration were not recorded.
Cold boot, persistent installation, graphics output, touch operation and WLAN association were outside this run.
